layer1.name: Carrd
layer1.one_liner: A builder for simple, responsive, one-page websites.
layer1.description: Deliberately scoped to single-page sites only, at $19/year. Built and run by one person, entering the most crowded software category there is.

sources.note: Founder's AMA disclosing $1M ARR and 2.5M sites
